mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prison_sentence (prisoner_no, name, cell, crime_type, entry_date, original_sentence, sentence_start, reduced_months, release_date, parole, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{prisonerNo}, #{name}, #{cell}, #{crimeType}, #{entryDate}, #{originalSentence}, #{sentenceStart}, #{reducedMonths}, #{releaseDate}, #{parole}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE prison_sentence SET prisoner_no = #{prisonerNo}, name = #{name}, cell = #{cell}, crime_type = #{crimeType}, entry_date = #{entryDate}, original_sentence = #{originalSentence}, sentence_start = #{sentenceStart}, reduced_months = #{reducedMonths}, release_date = #{releaseDate}, parole = #{parole}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(prisoner_no, 7, 4) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM prison_sentence WHERE prisoner_no LIKE CONCAT('RJ', #{year}, '%')
